questions.question: What do Kogane look like, and how do individual Kogane differ?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Kogane are small, white shikigami with skull-shaped heads, cylinder-shaped bodies, and wings. Each Kogane also has a black tail but they differ from one to another. Kogane can differ in other ways as well, such as the shape of their eyes or added facial features, such as hair.(Chapter 167, Episode 56)

questions.question: Can Kogane speak?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: They're capable of speaking and each of them even possesses semblances of personality.

questions.question: What role does a Kogane play for a Culling Game player?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Each Culling Game player receives a Kogane that services them as their main point of contact with the Culling Game.(Chapter 146, Episode 50)

questions.question: What does Kogane do for each player besides scoring updates?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: It goes over the rules with each player(Chapter 161, Episode 54) and tells them every time they've scored points.(Chapter 168, Episode 57)

questions.question: How do Kogane announce newly added rules to players?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Kogane will announce newly added rules to their players in a different voice than when acting as a liaison for a player.(Chapter 158, Episode 53, Episode 54)

questions.question: How did Master Tengen describe the Kogane to Yuji Itadori?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Master Tengen first mentioned the Kogane when discussing the Culling Game with Yuji Itadori and his allies, describing them as the programming of the game rather than the actual masters of it.(Chapter 146, Episode 50)

questions.question: How did Yuji and Megumi Fushiguro use Kashimo's player-information rule?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Yuji and Megumi Fushiguro used the new rule to have Kogane show players with one hundred or more points. This allows them to prioritize Hajime Kashimo and Hiromi Higuruma as targets so they can use their points to add their own rule to the game with Kogane.(Chapter 158, Episode 53, Episode 54)

questions.question: What did Kogane warn Megumi before he entered the Tokyo No.1 Colony?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Before entering the Tokyo No.1 Colony, Kogane warned Megumi that a lethal contest called the Culling Game has begun inside the barrier and entering would make him a player. With Yuji already considered a player, Kogane only required confirmation from Megumi.

questions.question: How did Hiromi Higuruma add the rule allowing the transfer of points?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Higuruma agreed with Yuji to use his points to add a rule that allowed the transfer of points between players. Using Kogane, Higuruma negotiated with the game master that this rule would affect Rule 8 involving Cursed Technique Removal. The rule was approved as the tenth rule of the game and Higuruma used his Kogane to transfer one point to Yuji.(Chapter 167, Episode 56)

questions.question: What did Reggie Star ask his Kogane to do before he was killed?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: After Reggie Star was defeated by Megumi, he asked Kogane to transfer his 41 points to the young sorcerer who then killed him. Megumi's Kogane then announced that he earned five more points.(Chapter 173, Episode 58)

questions.question: How did Kashimo expose Panda's identity in the Tokyo No. 2 Colony?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Although he tried to disguise himself as an actual panda, Kashimo made use of Kogane's ability to identify other Culling Game players, exposing Panda's identity and promptly engaging in battle with him.(Chapter 184)

questions.question: How did Yuta Okkotsu reach a total of 190 points in the three-way battle?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Yuta was given 76 points from Ryu and 69 points from Uro, leaving both players with one point so that they wouldn't need to kill others to gain points and survive the Culling Game. Yuta had a total 190 points after the ordeal.(Chapter 181, Episode 59)(Volume 21)

questions.question: How many points did the jujutsu sorcerers hold on the night of the 14th?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Combined with Megumi's 51 points, Fumihiko Takaba's 4 points, and Hana Kurusu's 14 points, the jujutsu sorcerers gained a total of 359 points.(Chapter 199)

questions.question: What rule did Tsumiki Fushiguro add with the 100 points Megumi transferred to her?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: However, Tsumiki instead uses the points to add a rule that would allow players entry and exit across colony borders.(Chapter 211) The rule was immediately approved by Tsumiki's Kogane and announced, who taunted Megumi by revealing that she was an incarnated sorcerer named Yorozu all along.(Chapter 212)

questions.question: Why did the Kogane accept Kenjaku's rule barring new players?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: This created a glitch since both options would disrupt the Culling Game's continuance, causing the Kogane to accept Kenjaku's new rule since it was more sustainable.

questions.question: What did the 15th rule of the Culling Game grant to Megumi Fushiguro?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Amidst the chaos, he had his Kogane add the 15th rule to the Culling Game, granting Megumi Fushiguro (Sukuna) the authority to activate the merger of humankind with Tengen. The rule was approved and announced to the sorcerers battling Sukuna in Shinjuku, causing Tengen's remains to fly towards Tokyo to be consumed by Sukuna.(Chapter 248)(Chapter 249)

questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Each Culling Game player receives a Kogane that services them as their main point of contact with the Culling Game.

questions.question: How does Kogane adapt to new rules added to the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: As the Culling Game's main interface, Kogane is capable of adapting to each added rule to the Culling Game. For example, when the rule allowing players to access each other's info was added, Kogane gained the ability to change its shape and display player information on command.

questions.question: What rule did Higuruma add to the Culling Game by using his points?
questions.subject: Kogane

answer.item: Higuruma agreed with Yuji to use his points to add a rule that allowed the transfer of points between players.
